title: Beyond Answer Sharing: TrueMAD for Targeted Peer Engagement in Multi-Agent Debate
abstract: arXiv:2610.18240v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent debate (MAD) aims to improve large language model reasoning by exposing agents to alternative solutions and enabling iterative revision. However, standard broadcast-style MAD makes peer answers visible without requiring agents to engage with a particular peer claim. As a result, reliable reasoning may be suppressed by conflicting or majority responses, limiting achievable performance, while erroneous reasoning may persist and degrade final predictions without actionable feedback. We propose TrueMAD, a backbone-agnostic test-time plug-in that introduces one-to-one, free-form peer advice between answer broadcasting and self-revision. Each source agent responds to a target's current reasoning through support, rebuttal, refinement, or further questions, while the target retains control over how to revise. translated_title: 超越答案共享：TrueMAD 实现多智能体辩论中的定向同伴互动
translated_abstract: 多智能体辩论（MAD）旨在通过让智能体接触替代解决方案并支持迭代修订来提升大语言模型的推理能力。然而，标准的广播式 MAD 只是让同伴答案可见，并不要求智能体针对某个特定的同伴主张进行互动。其结果是，可靠的推理可能被冲突性或多数派回应所压制，从而限制可达到的性能；而错误的推理可能在缺乏可操作反馈的情况下持续存在并降低最终预测的质量。我们提出 TrueMAD，这是一种与骨干模型无关的测试时即插即用插件，它在答案广播与自我修订之间引入了一对一、自由形式的同伴建议。每个源智能体通过支持、反驳、改进或进一步提问来回应目标智能体当前的推理，同时目标智能体保留对如何修订的最终控制权。同一机制无需参数更新即可增强标准 MAD 及其改进变体。在 AIME、GPQA-Diamond 等基准上……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: TrueMAD 提出一种无需参数更新的即插即用机制，通过在多智能体辩论的答案广播与自我修订之间引入一对一的定向同伴建议（支持、反驳、改进或追问），解决了广播式辩论中可靠推理被压制、错误推理无法被纠正的问题。
en_tdlr: TrueMAD is a parameter-update-free plug-in that injects one-to-one, targeted peer advice (support, rebuttal, refinement, or further questions) between answer broadcasting and self-revision in multi-agent debate, addressing the suppression of reliable reasoning and the persistence of flawed reasoning in broadcast-style MAD.
